intent: A dust-white quarryman's mourning set: a wide flat dust brim and face veil under a single cold slate crown, a dust-caked tunic under a crossed leather-and-rope climbing harness, with chisels and a rusted mallet hung like grave goods, reading as a pale stone family from the high camera.
requests: A shared Kit tone for cool quarry grey and stone-dust white; the set carries its own so it stays apart from the linen set's warm oatmeal.
A safe stone material (Granite or Slate) for the cut-stone pauldron slabs, which use Metal today.
